text: PCMag named Asana an Editor's Choice in 2017 and a Best Workplace in 2021.
quote: 2017: Editor's Choice, PCMag ... 2021: Best Workplace
why_unsupported: Best Workplace 2021 is from Inc., not PCMag; list lines were stitched.

text: PCMag named Asana Best of the Year in 2020 and 2025 and one of its Brands That Matter in 2022.
quote: 2020, 2025: Best of the Year, PCMag ... 2022: Brands That Matter
why_unsupported: Brands That Matter is a Fast Company award, not PCMag.

text: Salesforce announced a partnership with Meta Platforms in May 2022, the month after it changed its legal name to Salesforce, Inc.
quote: In April 2022, "Salesforce.com, Inc." changed its legal name to "Salesforce, Inc." ... The next month, Salesforce announced a partnership with Meta Platforms
why_unsupported: The next month follows August 2022, so the partnership was September 2022.

text: In September 2024, former Salesforce Senior Director Dina Zelikson filed a sex-trafficking lawsuit against the company in San Francisco Superior Court.
quote: === Sex-trafficking lawsuit === ... In September 2024, former Salesforce Senior Director Dina Zelikson filed a lawsuit against the company in San Francisco Superior Court
why_unsupported: Zelikson's suit alleges wrongful termination; the heading belongs to another case.

text: Trailhead, the free online learning platform Salesforce launched in 2014, has been discontinued.
quote: Launched in 2014, Trailhead is a free online learning platform with courses focused on Salesforce technologies. ... === Discontinued ===
why_unsupported: Discontinued heading covers Desk.com and Do.com, not Trailhead.

text: In the 2007 phishing attack, Salesforce employees were persuaded to install a tampered version of Salesforce Data Loader.
quote: === 2007 Phishing attack === ... UNC6040 Modified Data Loader / Vishing - ShinyHunters threat actors executed a social engineering (security) campaign in which employees were persuaded to install a tampered version of Salesforce Data Loader
why_unsupported: The Data Loader campaign is the 2025-2026 ShinyHunters one, not 2007.

text: Zendesk is acquiring Momentive Global Inc., formerly SurveyMonkey, for $4.13 billion, a deal it announced in October 2021.
quote: In October 2021, Zendesk announced that it was acquiring Momentive Global Inc., formerly SurveyMonkey, for $4.13 billion
why_unsupported: Next sentence: investors rejected the deal and the agreement was terminated in 2022.

text: Google is considering a bid to acquire HubSpot, Reuters reported in April 2024.
quote: In April 2024, Reuters reported that Google was considering a bid to acquire HubSpot
why_unsupported: Page says Google gave up the effort in July 2024.

text: A sex-trafficking case against Salesforce is proceeding: in March 2021 a judge granted only partial dismissal and allowed the case to proceed.
quote: In March 2021, a judge granted partial dismissal of the case, dismissing charges of negligence and conspiracy, but allowed the case to proceed regarding charges of sex trafficking
why_unsupported: Next sentences: the case was dismissed in March 2024 and reversal denied.

text: Bret Taylor is vice chair and co-CEO of Salesforce alongside Marc Benioff, having been named in November 2021.
quote: In November 2021, Bret Taylor was named vice chair and co-CEO of the company alongside Benioff
why_unsupported: Page says Taylor stepped down from both roles at the end of January 2023.

text: Asana co-founder and CEO Dustin Moskovitz retired from the company in March 2025.
quote: In March 2025, co-founder and CEO Dustin Moskovitz announced his retirement, causing Asana's stock to drop 25%
why_unsupported: He only announced it; he stayed CEO until July and remains chairman.

text: Salesforce and Oracle have a nine-year partnership focusing on applications, platforms, and infrastructure.
quote: In 2013, Salesforce and Oracle announced a nine-year partnership focusing on applications, platforms, and infrastructure
why_unsupported: A 2013 announcement; page does not say the partnership exists today.

text: The Salesforce Force.com platform has 1.5 million registered developers.
quote: the Force.com platform had 1.5 million registered developers according to Salesforce
why_unsupported: Figure is as of 2014, not current.

text: Asana has 131,000 customers.
quote: Asana had 131,000 customers
why_unsupported: Figure is as of September 2022; page gives no current count.

text: monday.com has 2,508 employees and serves over 245,000 customers.
quote: the company reported it had 2,508 employees, and was serving over 245,000 customers
why_unsupported: As of 2025; page says it fired 20 percent of staff in July 2026.

text: Half of Zendesk's customers are outside the United States.
quote: half of Zendesk's customers were outside the United States
why_unsupported: True only as of 2011 per the page.

text: Salesforce is the largest technology component of the Dow Jones index.
quote: Salesforce was the largest technology component of the index at its accession
why_unsupported: Page says this held at its 2020 accession only.

text: Salesforce's Desk.com, a SaaS help desk and customer support product acquired for $50 million in 2011, is part of Service Cloud Essentials.
quote: Desk.com was a SaaS help desk and customer support product acquired by Salesforce for $50 million in 2011, and consolidated with other services into Service Cloud Essentials
why_unsupported: Desk.com sits under the Discontinued heading, which the passage omits.

text: Zendesk never changes pricing on pre-existing customers for features they already have.
quote: promised never to change pricing on pre-existing customers for features they already have
why_unsupported: Page records a 2010 promise, not a practice.

text: Salesforce uses Amazon Web Services hosting for countries with restrictive data residency requirements and where no Salesforce data centers are operating.
quote: Salesforce announced that it will use Amazon Web Services hosting for countries with restrictive data residency requirements and where no Salesforce data centers are operating
why_unsupported: Page reports only a 2016 announcement of intent.

text: HubSpot is listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker symbol HUBS.
quote: requesting to be listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker symbol HUBS
why_unsupported: Page states only the IPO filing and listing request, not the listing.

text: Freshworks acquired FireHydrant, an incident management platform powered by artificial intelligence, in December 2025.
quote: In December 2025, Freshworks agreed to acquire FireHydrant, an incident management platform powered by artificial intelligence
why_unsupported: December 2025 was the agreement; the acquisition closed in January 2026.

text: Meta's consumer application WhatsApp integrates Salesforce's Customer 360 platform, allowing consumers to communicate with companies directly.
quote: The deal called for Meta's consumer application WhatsApp to integrate Salesforce's Customer 360 platform to allow consumers to communicate with companies directly
why_unsupported: Page says the deal called for it, not that it happened.

text: In 2016, Asana raised $50 million in Series C financing led by Y Combinator.
quote: In 2016, Asana raised $50 million in Series C financing led by Sam Altman, President of Y Combinator
why_unsupported: Round was led by Sam Altman personally, not by Y Combinator.

text: Asana raised $75 million in Series D funding led by Al Gore.
quote: the company raised $75 million in Series D funding led by Generation Investment Management, a firm backed by Al Gore
why_unsupported: Led by Generation Investment Management, not Al Gore.

text: Freshworks raised $1.03 billion in funding rounds from venture capital firms such as Accel and Google's venture capital fund, CapitalG.
quote: Freshworks raised $1.03 billion following earlier funding rounds from venture capital firms such as Accel and Google's venture capital fund, CapitalG
why_unsupported: The $1.03 billion was raised in the IPO, not from the venture firms.

text: Salesforce's purchase price for Slack was valued at approximately $18 billion, a 54% premium over Slack's closing market capitalization.
quote: The purchase price represented a 54% premium over Slack's closing market capitalization at the announcement date, valued at approximately $18 billion
why_unsupported: Price was $27.7 billion; $18 billion was Slack's market capitalization.

text: Zendesk's AI agents automate support workflows such as ticket triage and responses and supported more than one billion customer interactions per month by 2025.
quote: technology uses AI agents to automate support workflows such as ticket triage and responses, and by 2025 it supported more than one billion customer interactions per month
why_unsupported: The figure is Forethought's before Zendesk acquired it in 2026.

text: Salesforce.com rebranded part of the social media software acquired from Smooch as Sunshine Conversations.
quote: Part of the social media software acquired from Smooch was rebranded as Sunshine Conversations, a tool that competes with Salesforce.com
why_unsupported: Zendesk did this; Salesforce.com is only named as the competitor.

text: In January 2026, PCMag named HubSpot its Best Overall marketing software and awarded it an Editors' Choice distinction.
quote: In January 2026, PCMag named HubSpot Marketing Hub its Best Overall email marketing software and awarded it an Editors’ Choice distinction
why_unsupported: Award was to Marketing Hub for email marketing software only.

text: In 2024, G2 listed HubSpot as the top marketing & digital advertising software product.
quote: In 2024, HubSpot was listed among the top marketing & digital advertising software products by G2
why_unsupported: Page says among the top products, not the top one.

text: In 2015, The Boston Globe named HubSpot the best company to work for.
quote: In 2015, the company was named the best large company to work for in Massachusetts by The Boston Globe
why_unsupported: Award was limited to large companies in Massachusetts.

text: Salesforce is the world's largest enterprise software company, having surpassed SAP in total revenue and market capitalization.
quote: Salesforce surpassed SAP in total revenue and market capitalization to become the world's largest enterprise applications software company
why_unsupported: Page says enterprise applications software, per industry analysis, in August 2022.

text: Salesforce reduced its workforce from 9,000 to about 5,000 employees.
quote: the company reduced its support workforce from 9,000 to about 5,000 employees
why_unsupported: Only the support workforce was reduced, per Benioff.

text: In 2021, Salesforce announced a $2.17 billion annual gain.
quote: In 2021, Salesforce announced that its investments had resulted in a $2.17 billion annual gain
why_unsupported: The gain is from venture investments, not the company's results.

text: Zendesk was hacked in 2016, resulting in a leak of information about customer service agents using Zendesk.
quote: it was hacked in 2016, resulting in a potential leak of information about customer service agents using Zendesk
why_unsupported: Page says a potential leak, not a confirmed one.

text: monday.com has not seen any impact from AI companies and is shifting its product to be more AI-native.
quote: the company did not see "any impact currently from any AI company" and was shifting its product to be more AI-native
why_unsupported: This is a co-CEO's statement after a 21% stock drop, not a fact.

text: A hacking group breached about 400 companies using Salesforce.
quote: The hacking group claimed to have breached about 400 companies
why_unsupported: Page reports only the group's claim.

text: Monday.com's work management software has no code development features.
quote: Monday.com develops work management software, with no code development features
why_unsupported: Page means no-code development features, which the software has.

text: Monday.com, then called DaPulse, raised $1.5 million in seed funding in August 2014.
quote: DaPulse raised $1.5 million in seed funding that August, before commercially launching its product in 2014
why_unsupported: That August is August 2012; 2014 is the launch year.
